imageAlt: ING & YVE leather piping stitched by hand
statBody: From wool felt and vegetable-tanned leather to clay and hardware, our material journey stays remarkably close to home.

features.title: Close to home
features.text: Shorter chains, known makers and materials selected at their source.

features.title: Circular by design
features.text: Replaceable shades, repairable fittings and forms intended to endure.

features.title: A stitched signature
features.text: Every leather edge is double stitched slowly, visibly and by hand.

features.title: Natural texture
features.text: Wool felt, clay and wood bring depth without unnecessary finish.

ceramicBody: Our bases are built through a dialogue with clay. Finger marks, firing variation and the movement of glaze remain visible. What industry calls inconsistency, we recognize as life.

seo.title: Our Craft
seo.description: Inside the Dutch atelier: local materials, ceramic forms, wool felt and our leather stitched signature.
